jobs.name: base
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D side-scrolling Korean folklore game sprite, ONE complete character on true transparent alpha background, no shadow. A cheerful brave chibi child shaman with two black hair buns, cream wide sleeves, red collar and short red coat, navy trousers, yellow waist knot, holding one round gold handbell, rides astride a new Korean haetae guardian beast. Child's head is 60% the width of beast's head, clearly visible above the mane, left hand grips saddle handle, legs astride. Haetae faces RIGHT in near side profile, four short sturdy legs with broad paws, rounded muzzle, one short gold forehead horn, rounded eyebrows, ivory pale jade body #E0EEE4, deep teal #387B78 mane made of three big cloud curls, one short tail with teal cloud tuft. Slightly elongated body supports rider. Navy low saddle with handle, vivid red saddlecloth with thick gold edge and one cloud motif, broad navy breast strap with one gold round clasp, gold knot and two short tassels at rear saddle. ONE upright flagpole fixed to REAR of saddle behind rider on LEFT side of composition; ONE red rectangular flag with gold border and a simple symmetrical gold knot symbol, waving toward LEFT, flag tip taller than child's head, never covers face. No letters. Cute cohesive rounded SD cartoon, thick dark brown/ink outlines, crisp flat color fills, restrained two tone shading, very light paper texture, existing casual mobile Korean cartoon game style, readable at 70 pixels tall. All four feet planted in neutral standing idle pose, warm confident expression. Square canvas, entire animal child tail flag included with generous margin, ground at 87.5% canvas height and body midpoint at 50% canvas width, flag top around 7%, child top around20%. No background, no checkerboard, no text, no UI, no additional animals, no weapons, no wings, no armor, no photorealism, no excessive fur, no extra limbs, no extra flag. ONE POSE ONLY.

jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE production walking-animation sprite sheet for the exact mounted haetae child character in the reference. True transparent background. Each cell contains the full same character including rear red flag, child and all paws with 8% margin. Order left-to-right top-to-bottom: walk_00,walk_01,walk_02,walk_03. All characters face RIGHT, identical camera, identical anatomical proportions, identical colors, facial features and equipment. Every cell has the SAME ground line 88% down the cell, SAME saddle attachment position, and SAME body scale. Ivory pale jade haetae with teal curled mane, one gold horn, four short legs, one short cloud tail; red/navy/gold saddlecloth and harness, one rear left flagpole with red/gold flag; cream sleeves/red vest/navy trousers child, two hair buns, one gold handbell. Preserve reference design precisely. Animate REAL four-beat walking IN PLACE: frame1 near hind leg lifted forward, remaining three paws contact ground; frame2 near foreleg lifted forward, near hind landed, small body downstroke; frame3 far hind lifted forward, near fore landed, body rises to neutral; frame4 far fore lifted forward, far hind landed, second small downstroke, ready to loop into frame1. Draw obviously different leg joint and paw positions in every frame, no duplicated idle poses. Rider bobs subtly WITH fixed saddle, pelvis never detaches. Flag fabric and two tassels wave subtly with delay while pole base stays attached. Keep head size and gaze unchanged. No jumping, running, floating, extra legs, extra characters, background, floor shadow, checkerboard, words, frames touching, cropped flags, or particle effects. This single asset is a 4-frame animation sheet.
